name: lbBulletChart
description: Actual vs. target with qualitative performance bands (poor / satisfactory / good).

name: lbCalendarHeatmap
description: Daily values laid out on a calendar grid to reveal weekly and seasonal patterns.

name: lbParetoChart
description: Sorted bars with cumulative-percentage line and 80/20 cut-off to focus on the vital few.

name: lbControlChart
description: Statistical process control (XmR / individuals) chart with mean, control limits and signal detection.

name: lbBoxPlot
description: Distribution of values per category: median, quartiles, whiskers and outliers.

name: lbSankeyFlow
description: Flow diagram showing how a quantity moves between stages, sources and destinations.

name: lbBaselineGantt
description: Planned (baseline) vs. actual / forecast schedule bars with slip days, % complete and a today line.

name: lbMilestoneTimeline
description: Milestones and events plotted on swimlanes against time, coloured by status, with a today line.

name: lbVarianceChart
description: Actual vs. plan (or prior year) columns with absolute and % variance bars, IBCS style.

name: lbStatusGrid
description: Tile grid of projects / assets with red-amber-green status, key metric and owner.
